p01.why: Several attributes can share a specifier, specifiers can follow each other, an empty specifier is allowed, and a using prefix applies to the attribute inside.

p02.why: An assumption must not have a comma operator at its top level; Clang 18 does not implement assume and accepts.

p04.why: The assumption's expression must convert to bool and X does not; Clang 18 ignores assume and accepts.

p05.why: The attribute specifier comes before the const of the *; GCC and EDG reject this, Clang accepts it (Q-0123).

p06.why: Each unused variable runs a user-provided constructor or destructor, so no unused-variable warning is given.

p07.why: likely and unlikely change nothing; classify(5) is 1 and classify(-5) is -1, so main returns 0.

p08.why: holder is never read and its creation runs no user-provided constructor, so the unused-variable warning becomes an error under -Werror.

p09.why: local is never read, and -Werror turns the warning into an error.

p10.why: count is only assigned and never read, so it warns, and -Werror makes it an error.

p11.why: nodiscard on a variable; Clang and GCC accept with a warning, EDG rejects, and the provisional answer is reject (Q-0021).

p12.why: Case 0 ends with an if and else whose branches both end in break, so control does not fall through.

p13.why: Creating holder runs Guard's user-provided constructor, so no warning is given.

p14.why: The lambda in the subscript is in parentheses, so the two [ tokens are not adjacent.

p15.why: carries_dependency can apply to a function and to a parameter on the first declaration.

p16.why: noreturn cannot be added to a function first declared without it.

p17.why: case 0 is directly followed by case 1, and case 1 ends with break, so nothing falls through.

p18.why: With no arguments argc is 1, so the assumption is false, and the sanitizer stops the program; Clang 18 ignores assume, so its build runs and exits 0.

p19.why: fallthrough must be a statement on its own in a switch, not on a declaration.

p20.why: nodiscard takes at most one string literal.

p21.why: Two members of the same empty type keep distinct addresses, so main returns 0.

p22.why: likely and unlikely on one statement; GCC accepts, Clang and EDG reject, and the provisional answer is reject (Q-0046).

p23.why: Creating holder runs the user-provided constructor of the array elements inside a member, so no warning is given.

p26.why: The result of a nodiscard function is discarded, and -Werror turns the warning into an error.

p27.why: The fallthrough ends the else branch, and the next statement that can run after it has a case label.

p28.why: fallthrough must be inside a switch and followed by a labeled statement.

p29.why: The fallthrough statement is immediately before the next label, so no warning is given.

p31.why: deprecated takes no argument or one string literal, and 42 is not a string literal.

p32.why: arr[[ starts an attribute specifier, so the lambda index needs parentheses.

p33.why: With a using prefix, an attribute in the specifier must not have its own namespace.

p34.why: maybe_unused on the parameter and the variable silences the unused warnings.

p35.why: Control can return from the noreturn function, Clang and GCC warn, and -Werror makes the warning an error.

p36.why: The fallthrough ends the if branch, and the next statement that can run has a case label.

p37.why: check returns a nodiscard type and the result is discarded, which warns, and -Werror makes it an error.

p38.why: use calls a deprecated function, which warns, and -Werror makes it an error.

p39.why: The assumption v > 0 is true for f(1), so the constant evaluation succeeds.

p40.why: carries_dependency added on a redeclaration; GCC accepts, Clang and EDG reject, and the provisional answer is reject (Q-0108).

p41.why: The statement after the fallthrough has no case or default label.

p42.why: Every matrix compiler gives an empty no_unique_address member no storage, and a plain empty member takes storage.

p43.why: point is never read and has no user-provided constructor or destructor, so the warning becomes an error.

p44.why: Casting the result to void silences the nodiscard warning.

p45.why: The deprecated function is only defined and never used, so there is no warning.

p47.why: no_unique_address on a bit-field; GCC accepts, Clang and EDG reject, and the provisional answer is reject (Q-0021).

p48.why: Each position is one the table allows, and an unknown attribute is ignored with a warning.

p49.why: When wide is false, control falls from case 0 into case 1 without fallthrough, which warns under -Wimplicit-fallthrough, and -Werror makes it an error.

p50.why: main can be declared noreturn; a run would loop forever, so no exit status is given.

p51.why: noreturn on a variable; GCC accepts, Clang and EDG reject, and the provisional answer is reject (Q-0021).

p52.why: Case 0 ends with a call of a noreturn function, so control does not fall through.

p53.why: The use of a deprecated enumerator warns, and -Werror makes it an error.

p54.why: deprecated is added on a later declaration, the use comes after it and warns, and -Werror makes it an error.

p55.why: The assumption is not evaluated, so i stays 1 and main returns 0.

p56.why: An assumption must not apply to a declaration; Clang 18 ignores assume and accepts.

p57.why: A noreturn function can contain return; the compilers warn, but without -Werror the warning is not an error.

p58.why: The temporary made by a nodiscard constructor is discarded, which warns, and -Werror makes it an error.

p59.why: The using prefix applies gnu to unused, which carries no namespace of its own.

p60.why: Unknown attributes are ignored, also with arguments.

p61.why: The infinite loop means control cannot return, so there is no warning to turn into an error.

p63.why: Case 0 falls through to case 1 without fallthrough, which warns, and -Werror makes it an error.

p64.why: The assumption is false during constant evaluation, which every compiler except Clang 18 rejects.

p65.why: Destroying file runs the base's user-provided destructor, so no warning is given.

p66.why: The structured binding declaration is never read, which warns, and -Werror makes it an error.

p67.why: An attribute after the const of the * is accepted by GCC and EDG and rejected by Clang (Q-0123).

p68.why: With argc 1 stop returns, which is undefined, and the sanitizer stops the program.

p69.why: Each case ends in continue, goto, throw, or return, and default is last, so nothing falls through.

p70.why: The call returns a reference to the nodiscard type, so there is no warning.

p71.why: A fallthrough at the end of a loop body inside the switch is not valid.

p72.why: GCC 14 rejects an attribute before a base class and after the array bound of new; GCC 16, Clang, and EDG accept (Q-0177).
